About the Project

The Wellcome Sanger Institute’s four-year PhD programme trains researchers in genomics through experimental and computational rotations. Students later select a laboratory and register for a Cambridge PhD.

Research Areas

  • Genomics
  • Experimental biology
  • Computational biology

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull tuition regardless of nationality; visa and Immigration Health Surcharge reimbursed.
MaintenanceOctober 2026 reference: years 1–4 GBP 25,649; 26,228; 26,806; 27,385
Duration4 years; 1 October 2027 start

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant scientific preparation; meet Cambridge’s academic and English admission requirements before entry. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 applications open
DeadlineApplication: 24 November 2026, 09:00 GMT; references: 1 December 2026, 09:00 GMT

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://forms.sanger.ac.uk/form/Sanger_PhD_Application

Source: forms.sanger.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 24 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit the Sanger programme form with transcripts and two referees. Ensure reference submissions meet their separate deadline; selected candidates later apply to Cambridge.

Twelve funded places are advertised. Students undertake three rotations during the first eight months before choosing their final laboratory. The displayed stipend rates are October 2026 references.

About Wellcome Sanger Institute

The Wellcome Sanger Institute is a genomics research institute on the Wellcome Genome Campus in Hinxton, Cambridgeshire. Its four-year PhD programme combines laboratory and computational rotations before students choose their research group. Successful students register for a University of Cambridge PhD.
